$comment: B072 workspace shell tokens (specs/22, the B072 design brief). One source for both hosts: the web shell reads them as CSS custom properties (apps/web/shell/shell.css, checked against this file by `just test-shell-web`), the Mac app as a Swift enum. Lengths are points on Apple platforms and CSS pixels on the web. Colours are sRGB hex; a highlight swatch is a colour with the opacity it is painted at. Tool keys are not here: they come from the core registry (bare_key shortcuts).

reading.$size_steps: The core stores reading.text_size_step; step 0 is default_size and each step moves one entry along sizes, clamped to the list

measure_cap.$comment: Derived from the core, recorded here for reference only: hosts read layoutConstants() (measure_cap_standard_pt, measure_cap_accessibility_pt); the web test fails if these differ

$highlights: The four swatches the tool palette offers (tool.swatch takes the colour as #RRGGBB); the seed session starts on yellow with green as the alternate.
